author: Bobby Grayson
description: Adds never conflict (distinct filenames). Same-node concurrent edits conflict on one small JSON file, which is a real conflict worth surfacing. No checkpoint, no compaction, no clock-ordered replay, no timestamp filter. Git history becomes readable per decision. Write-through happens in the Database layer so CLI, MCP, and HTTP API all publish. Local integer ids stay per-machine aliases; change_id prefixes become accepted anywhere an id is.
title: Choose per-record files as the single sync mechanism; fold events/patches/checkpoint into 'deciduous sync'
